text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, hello...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...T-This is...
My sister forced me to...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Cheval really loves
meat buns, you know.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't need to say it.
I'll eat it, so... let's go.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about to begin.
—The 'Japan Cup.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bustling annual 'Japan Cup'...
Once again, a massive crowd had gathered this year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Whoa...! An amazing bunch of Umamusume have gathered this year too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh.
Hey, don't the odds look kind of weird?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Why is Gentildonna-san the 3rd favorite?
She proved how crazy strong she is on the Tiara route, didn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well, that's definitely why everyone's watching, but...
There are just way too many worrying factors, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Historically, no Classic-year Tiara runner
has ever won this race, plus...
there's the gate draw. An inside gate has the track advantage—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna drew an outside gate just like Tosen Jordan.
Man, this is gonna be tough~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If that's the case,
Orfevre-san is on the outermost gate!
And yet she's still the favorite to win, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, you, that's our biggest worry of all!
We're up against Orfevre, you know! Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Last year's Classic Triple Crown Umamusume!
And this year, a proud 2nd place in France's pinnacle GⅠ race, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre is the strongest Umamusume in Japan right now!
The 'absolute pinnacle'!
If there's any concern, it's just fatigue from the overseas trip, right?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I suppose that's a fair assessment... maybe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san, Eishin Flash-san...
There are so many other amazing Umamusume out there, but—
choice_data_list: Orfevre really is on another level, isn't she?
Orfevre really is on another level, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes. Coming in second at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was so very close, after all...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, Orfe-san is amazing.
However—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The one who wins is Gentildonna-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Because it must be so.
After all, she is... my rival.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of our generation on the Tiara route...
you must show us a run worthy of immense pride.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You will prove that our battle was among the highest caliber as well, won't you?
Gentil-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, this year's
Japan Cup gets underway—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
I knew she'd try to run!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san is toward the back of the midfield pack, huh...
While Gentil-san is—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's in a good position.
However... Orfevre-san is
moving up as well.
choice_data_list: But... the girl in the lead isn't slowing down either.
But... the girl up front isn't dropping her pace either.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, could she actually go wire-to-wire with this!?
Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: And here she comes, as expected!! Orfevre~~~!! And on top of that...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna-san...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre and Gentildonna.
The fierce duel between two of the greatest Umamusume of our time
sent the entire venue into pure delirium.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (No... I don't know... You being like this—...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna! Gentildonna!
No, Orfevre! Orfevre!
Gentildonna, Orfevre!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Such a happy-looking face.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Insolent pests!! 
Get out of my way, you insolent fools...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho!! No, the one stepping back... is you!!
—Now, falllll!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She's broken clean away! She's surging forward!!
Spreading wings of dreams... now!
She blows past them in the final stretch, aaaand it's overrr!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Why...
does she remind me of "that person"—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Gentildonna!
Neck and neck at the finish liiine!!
Gentildonna by a fraction?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa...! History has been rewritten...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
And going up against Orfevre of all people!
Gentildonna is just insane!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone.
I believe you understand now, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "The 'pinnacle' of this era... is none other than myself, Gentildonna."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please, continue to enjoy the show.
This power is—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To the point of trampling even the world itself.
Every single peak belongs to me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohohohoho...
O-ho-ho-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"...Th-This is seriously dangerous in so many ways!!
But if it's her... she might just pull it off."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
She totally transcends standard racing routes, doesn't she?
Completely and utterly...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Reaching for every peak means...
It feels like there's no chance she'll be returning to the Tiara route from here on, huhâ

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
She was amazing, Gentile-san...!
choice_data_list: It's frustrating, but you're as strong as ever...
It's frustrating, but you're as strong as ever, huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sorry. I think I just got a bit overwhelmed by the crowd...
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Want to go rest over there?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I am fine on my own.
Please look after Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I guess I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I knew she was strong.
I even thought she would win... and yet.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (To think she could be that overwhelmingly strong...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (It overlaps so much with the person I look up to... To think I'd be yearning for that kind of strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You idiot, self...! 
What was all that about 'a battle at the highest peak'...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (And here I thought we had become equals! That we were the ultimate rivals... And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...That day, I gave it my all.
And yet, you... hadn't shown me everything—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……How much stronger do I need to become……
to reach the "pinnacle"……? I――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
?
What was that just now...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay!?
You look kind of pale...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san... I'm all right.
I just got a little dizzy from the crowds.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well, they really are an amazing person after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's here to see her win...
...But...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-san.
That was Sion-san's... "Absolute", wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I never thought I'd lose.
It kinda... feels complicated.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... B-But,
Verxina is... even more...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, is that why, then?
Um...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Her strength was certainly shocking.
However, it's fine, there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I can grow... once more
before I face her...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you very much.
Talking with you, Shion-san,
has cheered me up a bit.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
But you still look a bit pale...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
See you back at the academy, then.
...Please don't let it get you down too much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...You can't talk about it, huh. Not to me...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I want to encourage you too...
—Just like you did for me..."
